get.description: Starts the OAuth2 authorization code flow. This endpoint redirects the user to login and consent (if needed), then redirects back to your `redirect_uri` with a `code` and `state`.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Must exactly match one of the app's configured redirect URIs.

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Must be `code` for the authorization code flow.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque value returned to your callback for CSRF protection.

parameters.name: code_challenge
parameters.description: PKCE code challenge. Required for public clients.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: PKCE challenge method (`plain` or `S256`). Required for public clients when using PKCE.

400.description: The request is invalid or missing required parameters.

401.description: Client authentication failed or the token is invalid.

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code for an access token, or exchanges a refresh token for a new access token. Send parameters as application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

400.description: The request is invalid or missing required parameters.

401.description: Client authentication failed or the token is invalid.

redirect_uri.description: Must match the redirect URI used in the authorization request.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token returned from a previous token exchange.

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier. Required for public clients.

post.description: Revokes an access token or refresh token. Send parameters as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

401.description: Client authentication failed or the token is invalid.

403.description: The authenticated client or token is not allowed to perform this action.

token.description: The access or refresh token to revoke.

token_type_hint.description: Optional hint to help the server process the token faster.

400.description: The request is invalid or missing required parameters.

401.description: Client authentication failed or the token is invalid.

token.description: The access or refresh token to introspect.

token_type_hint.description: Optional hint to help the server process the token faster.
